briefings.headline: Be ready for Baz’s fastball; stay disciplined on the curve
briefings.message: Shane Baz is the high-confidence expected starter. Left-handed hitters have the better overall matchup, so attack strikes—especially fastballs early. Recognize the knuckle curve and lay off it below the zone; it is his strongest put-away pitch. If he goes to the bullpen, watch for Rico Garcia, Andrew Kittredge, and Yennier Cano, all limited after pitching yesterday.
reminders: Mickey Gasper and Roman Anthony: look fastball first.
Wilyer Abreu, Adley Rutschman, and Nick Sogard: be ready for offspeed, but do not chase the curve.
Right-handed hitters: do not wait exclusively for the curve.

briefings.headline: Jake Bennett starts; keep power hitters off predictable fastballs
briefings.message: Jake Bennett gets the start. His matchup projections favor Jackson Holliday and Samuel Basallo, but several samples are small; Christian Encarnacion-Strand and Coby Mayo project as tougher matchups. Keep Pete Alonso’s fastball damage in check with breaking balls. Changeups and sinkers can disrupt the right-handed power bats; avoid predictable fastball patterns. Garrett Whitlock and Erik Miller are rested setup options, with Aroldis Chapman closing. Save the leverage arms for high-impact innings and use Alec Gamboa, Raymond Burgos, and Wyatt Olds only when needed.
reminders: Bennett’s planned limit is 90 pitches; work efficiently and limit free passes.
Against Christian Encarnacion-Strand and Coby Mayo, vary location and pitch choice.
In a close late game, bridge with Whitlock and Miller to Chapman.

briefings.headline: Execute the approved plan: left-handed lineup, rested leverage arms
briefings.message: The lineup is built around the high-confidence Shane Baz prediction and his more favorable results against left-handed hitters. Keep Wilyer Abreu and Nick Sogard in the order despite rest suggestions, as approved. Jake Bennett starts; protect the late-game bridge by leaning on rested Garrett Whitlock and Erik Miller before Aroldis Chapman. Alec Gamboa, Raymond Burgos, and Wyatt Olds are limited and should be used only when needed. Brayan Bello is unavailable.
reminders: Use the approved order and late defensive substitutions as planned.
Keep limited relievers out of routine leverage work.
Reassess the bullpen if Bennett exits early.
